# Upstream

`transformer.py` is from limxdynamics/troncamp-mani, commit
`7630a1a68558c2e64d9a17c54d4e4a907bca7db4`, at
`external/robotwin_local/policy/ACT/detr/models/transformer.py`.
Only the unused IPython debugger import is removed. The original DETR copyright
and license are retained in `DETR_LICENSE`; the ACT license is in `ACT_LICENSE`.
The surrounding single-camera model, data pipeline and trainer are local adapters.
